engineering_conclusion: Full in-RAM dense training of AnkaLM-8B (7,415,795,712 params) requires ~135 GB with AdamW or ~31 GB with BF16+Adafactor, exceeding the 12.79 GB free system RAM. While layer-by-layer NVMe memory-mapped streaming works at 78.33s/step (21.76 hours per 1,000 steps), the most productive in-RAM architectures for rapid convergence on this hardware are AnkaLM-Small (15.74M), AnkaLM-MoE (15.08M/10.36M active), and AnkaLM-Extended (41.96M).
